description.p: Annimate (for ANNIS Match Exporter) is a tool for the convenient export of query results (matches) from the ANNIS system for linguistic corpora.
It is meant as a supplement to the ANNIS web interface and focuses on file export (as opposed to visualization) of the results of an ANNIS query.
Annimate can produce a CSV or an Excel file with one row per match, showing

ul.li: the matched nodes in their context in a KWIC (Key Word in Context) format,
additional annotations of the matched nodes and the edges between them, and
metadata on the corpus and document levels.

description.p: It is similar in functionality to a combination of the ANNIS TextColumnExporter and CSVExporter, but provides a friendlier user interface.
